admission.justification: Deriving waves from prerequisite IDs and the matched child document status when available, with the declared master-row status only as fallback, prevents a separately stored or manually edited wave plan from lying about which unfinished work blocks the next task.

applicability: The current derived waves of an ordinary master’s explicitly listed task population.
conditions: waitsFor and current child-document status, or the declared master-row fallback when no child document is available, are inputs; waves are computed rather than persisted.
Tasks in work precede ready tasks; waiting tasks follow their latest unfinished prerequisite.
statement: Ordinary-master waves are derived, not stored, from waitsFor and each listed child document status when available, falling back to the declared master-row status otherwise; work precedes ready tasks and waiting tasks follow their latest unfinished prerequisite.
